col_count.description: Number of aligned columns to slice from col_start.

fasta_query.description: Multi-chain FASTA or ':'-separated sequences for ColabFold multimer MSA bundle synthesis.

sdp_rules.description: Specificity-determining position constraints (1-based centroid col=AA, comma-separated, e.g. '42=C,88=H').

where.description: Optional SQL-like metadata filter expression or prior @h_xxxx result handle (pct_id/cov to cluster centroid).
